caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass tumbler positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The tumbler is illustrated with detailed facets and etched patterns, including starburst and linear motifs that create reflective highlights and shadows. The glass is cylindrical, with a thick bottom and slightly tapered sides, and appears empty. The etched designs on the surface of the tumbler are rendered in shades of white, gray, and blue, giving the illusion of transparency and reflection. The background does not include any other objects or elements, and the artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner. The overall composition is minimal, with the focus on the form and texture of the glass.
title: Tumbler
